svg.title: AIcoach landing, Skeleton Hero (round 3, 04)

text.tspan: AIcoach watches one down-the-line clip from your
phone. It finds your body, marks the keypoints and
measures what moved. Then it tells you the fault,
how sure it is, and one thing to practise.

svg.text: Hip keypoint marked in every frame
Hip sits on the dashed line.
Still on the line at the top.
Your hips moved toward the ball by 7%[3] of your body height. That’s early extension.
Every pin on the figure is a measurement you can check.
One swing fits inside a range session.
Film on your phone, send the clip from the browser, read the answer before your next ball.

text.tspan: Phone behind you at hand height,
2.4–3.7 m away. One swing per clip.

The fault, how sure it is, one drill

svg.text: Three faults, checked against a fixed rule table.
If your swing shows something else, the coach says “No verified fault found”. It does not force one onto you.
Hips move toward the ball, address → impact
Posture angle change, downswing vs address
Hand path in transition above the backswing path
Capped at medium confidence: no club tracking.

Create an account, film a down-the-line clip, and read the answer at the range.
Your swing clips are private. Unsaved clips are deleted after analysis. Delete your account any time.
AIcoach is a practice tool — not for use during a competitive round. Mobility exercises are generic guidance, not medical advice.
